history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration review the classification of the status of employees to ensure that data in Umoja is consistent with the actual status, undertake a comprehensive review of retiree data to ensure its quality and accuracy in the granting of post-retirement benefits and classify retirees as a category that can be uniquely identified.
history.administration_response: Umoja already has a unique customer- specific status of “after-service health insurance/after-service life insurance” for all participants regardless of employee status. Furthermore, all retired staff are given the status “retiree” in Umoja. On this basis, no further validation or change to Umoja is needed and the Administration requests that this recommendation be closed.
history.board_assessment: Given that Umoja already has a unique customer- specific status of “after- service health insurance/after-service life insurance” for all participants regardless of employee status, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
